column1: # The skip ledger of the suite's annotations/ directory (README.md): one
# line per assertion the import does not answer yet, read by
# where file is the path under annotations/tests/, case is the case as
# the suite describes it, test is the test's place in the case from 1,
# location and keyword are the assertion's, construct is what the import
# says it lost, comma-joined, `-` when it lost nothing, or the code it
# refused the schema with, and phase is the phase of
# listed assertion the import answers fails the run, so a phase deletes
# the lines it clears and lowers the bound to match.
